model_output.score_comment_short: Recent bullets pair substantial financial responsibilities with specific results and audiences.
model_output.score_comment_long: The forecast and pricing bullets give a reviewer concrete financial results. The budget and variance bullets leave some of your day-to-day judgment unexplained. Adding a few specifics to those bullets would make the work easier to evaluate.
model_output.score_plain: Your resume gives a reviewer several concrete reasons to consider your FP&A work. A few added details would help distinguish how you handle the responsibilities behind the numbers.
model_output.first_impression: You work across budgeting, forecasting and pricing for consumer brands. The $240M annual operating budget gives the current role useful context, while the short bullets leave some of the work behind it unexplained.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Present monthly variance results to the division CFO and 4 brand leaders" names the audience but not the analysis or recommendations you bring to them.
model_output.summary: The driver-based forecast reduced full-year forecast error from 7% to 2.5%, a useful result because it connects your modeling work to forecast accuracy. Your recent work fits a senior individual-contributor FP&A role, spanning division budgeting and product pricing. A 2025 pricing review also added $3.1M in gross margin. The budget bullet doesn't yet explain which planning decisions you make, so a reviewer may have trouble distinguishing ownership from the tasks within it.
strengths: The pricing bullet pairs 60 products with a stated gross-margin result from the 2025 review.
Naming the division CFO and 4 brand leaders shows who receives your monthly variance results.
The Power BI sales flash includes a weekly time saving, making the automation's benefit easy to understand.
gaps: The budget bullet doesn't describe how you build or adjust the plan, leaving your planning process unclear.
The forecast bullet doesn't name its drivers, so the model's design remains difficult to assess.
The close reports cover 3 plants, but their contents and use aren't described.
